newsitem.title: USA: Glasgal asks 15-day delay for Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Glasgal asks 15-day delay for Q4 results.

text.p: Glasgal Communications Inc said Wednesday it has requested permission from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a 15-day extension to report results for its fiscal quarter and year ending April 30, 1997.

Glasgal said its management noted that since the acquisition of its principal, wholly owned subsidiary, Datatec Systems Inc, in October 1996 and other internal changes during the fiscal year, the company's business mix has changed from primarily hardware resale to predominately higher margin services offerings.
As a result Glasgal and its auditors are evaluating the possibility of reclassifying its financial statements to correspond more closely with those of other services-based companies, it said.
These changes could include the reporting of certain businesses as discontinued operations, effective in the fiscal fourth quarter, it said.
